Cybersecurity Department

Information is our advantage.

The Cybersecurity Department safeguards digital systems, examines electronic evidence and provides technical support to investigations. Its priorities are data integrity and protection of bureau information resources.

The department combines technical expertise with analytical work. Digital evidence, data integrity and information-system security support bureau investigations.

Area of work

Primary responsibilities

  • Investigation of digital offenses
  • Examination of electronic evidence
  • Information systems protection
  • Technical support for investigators
